scripts.build: node scripts/generate-firebase-sw.mjs && node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs && node scripts/generate-splash-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-notification-badge.mjs && node scripts/generate-legal-pages.mjs && vite build
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.release:android: npm run build && node scripts/generate-android-icons.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
